canonical_workbook: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx
method: Read-only audit of a bounded 100-record slice of blank website/hours/menu fields in public-access SFA catalogue records. First-party sources were checked for exact outlet identity. Only blank official website fields with address and unit matches were proposed. No nonblank values were replaced or cleared; no hours were inferred from brand pages. No paid sources or Mapbox used.

source_set.publisher: Din Tai Fung Singapore / Taster Food Pte Ltd
source_set.description: First-party Singapore outlet directory listing outlet names and exact addresses; also directs users to call outlets because operating hours vary.
